title: PORT-BRANCH-claude-branch-root-cause-1: carry claude/branch-root-cause-1 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `claude/branch-root-cause-1` at c6dacdd911 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: seed/worker/src/sweeper.js)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried claude/branch-root-cause-1
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch. Once idle the branch moves to `refs/archive/claude/branch-root-cause-1` (`git fetch origin refs/archive/claude/branch-root-cause-1`).

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried claude/branch-root-cause-1

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T13:51:12Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists


**Evidence:** 2026-11-21 python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried claude/branch-root-cause-1 -> rc=0: archived at c6dacdd911: superseded: main holds 20 of the 20 code lines it added (BRANCH-SWEEP-4). The one missing piece, the sweeper retrigger test, carried in this PR; node --test seed/worker/test/sweeper.test.js 8/8 pass.
